cards.back:
Not happy. The prefix un means not.
Bahasa Indonesia: tidak bahagia
Example: The unhappy puppy sat by the door and waited for its owner.
cards.say: unhappy. Not happy. The prefix un means not. The unhappy puppy sat by the door and waited for its owner.

cards.back:
To have a different opinion. The prefix dis means not or opposite.
Bahasa Indonesia: tidak setuju
Example: My brother and I disagree about which film is best.
cards.say: disagree. To have a different opinion. The prefix dis means not or opposite. My brother and I disagree about which film is best.

cards.back:
To appear again. The prefix re means again.
Bahasa Indonesia: muncul lagi
Example: The Sun will reappear after the dark clouds pass over us.
cards.say: reappear. To appear again. The prefix re means again. The Sun will reappear after the dark clouds pass over us.

cards.back:
To spell a word wrongly. The prefix mis means wrongly.
Bahasa Indonesia: salah mengeja
Example: It is easy to misspell the word necessary when you write quickly.
cards.say: misspell. To spell a word wrongly. The prefix mis means wrongly. It is easy to misspell the word necessary when you write quickly.

cards.back:
To see something before it is shown to everyone. The prefix pre means before.
Bahasa Indonesia: pratinjau, melihat lebih dulu
Example: We watched a preview of the film before it came out.
cards.say: preview. To see something before it is shown to everyone. The prefix pre means before. We watched a preview of the film before it came out.

cards.back:
Not able to be seen. The prefix in can mean not.
Bahasa Indonesia: tidak terlihat
Example: The glass was so clean that it looked almost invisible.
cards.say: invisible. Not able to be seen. The prefix in can mean not. The glass was so clean that it looked almost invisible.

cards.back:
Not able to happen. The prefix im can mean not.
Bahasa Indonesia: mustahil
Example: It is impossible to count every star in the sky.
cards.say: impossible. Not able to happen. The prefix im can mean not. It is impossible to count every star in the sky.

cards.back:
To cook for too long. The prefix over means too much.
Bahasa Indonesia: memasak terlalu lama
Example: If you overcook the rice, it becomes soft and sticky.
cards.say: overcook. To cook for too long. The prefix over means too much. If you overcook the rice, it becomes soft and sticky.

cards.back:
A ship that travels under the sea. The prefix sub means under.
Bahasa Indonesia: kapal selam
Example: The submarine dived deep below the surface of the ocean.
cards.say: submarine. A ship that travels under the sea. The prefix sub means under. The submarine dived deep below the surface of the ocean.

cards.back:
To carry things from one place to another. The prefix trans means across.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengangkut
Example: Lorries transport fruit from the farm to the city.
cards.say: transport. To carry things from one place to another. The prefix trans means across. Lorries transport fruit from the farm to the city.

cards.back:
A hero with powers greater than normal. The prefix super means above or beyond.
Bahasa Indonesia: pahlawan super
Example: The superhero flew over the city to save the children.
cards.say: superhero. A hero with powers greater than normal. The prefix super means above or beyond. The superhero flew over the city to save the children.

cards.back:
Half of a circle. The prefix semi means half.
Bahasa Indonesia: setengah lingkaran
Example: Our teacher asked us to sit in a semicircle on the carpet.
cards.say: semicircle. Half of a circle. The prefix semi means half. Our teacher asked us to sit in a semicircle on the carpet.

cards.back:
The quality of being kind. The suffix ness makes a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: kebaikan
Example: Her kindness made everyone in the class feel welcome.
cards.say: kindness. The quality of being kind. The suffix ness makes a noun. Her kindness made everyone in the class feel welcome.

cards.back:
Not taking care. The suffix less means without.
Bahasa Indonesia: ceroboh
Example: A careless mistake cost him two marks in the test.
cards.say: careless. Not taking care. The suffix less means without. A careless mistake cost him two marks in the test.

cards.back:
Giving help. The suffix ful means full of.
Bahasa Indonesia: suka menolong
Example: The helpful boy carried the bags for his neighbour.
cards.say: helpful. Giving help. The suffix ful means full of. The helpful boy carried the bags for his neighbour.

cards.back:
An act of moving. The suffix ment makes a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: gerakan
Example: A small movement in the grass caught the cat's eye.
cards.say: movement. An act of moving. The suffix ment makes a noun. A small movement in the grass caught the cat's eye.

cards.back:
Giving pleasure. The suffix able means able to be.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyenangkan
Example: The class trip to the farm was very enjoyable.
cards.say: enjoyable. Giving pleasure. The suffix able means able to be. The class trip to the farm was very enjoyable.

cards.back:
Something that someone has made. The suffix tion makes a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: ciptaan
Example: The clay bowl was her proudest creation of the year.
cards.say: creation. Something that someone has made. The suffix tion makes a noun. The clay bowl was her proudest creation of the year.

cards.back:
In a fast way. The suffix ly makes an adverb.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan cepat
Example: He quickly packed his bag when the bell rang.
cards.say: quickly. In a fast way. The suffix ly makes an adverb. He quickly packed his bag when the bell rang.

cards.back:
To write something again.
Bahasa Indonesia: menulis ulang
Example: Please rewrite the last paragraph so it is easier to read.
cards.say: rewrite. To write something again. Please rewrite the last paragraph so it is easier to read.

cards.back:
Without fear.
Bahasa Indonesia: tak kenal takut
Example: The fearless firefighter ran into the smoky building.
cards.say: fearless. Without fear. The fearless firefighter ran into the smoky building.

cards.back:
A feeling of being slightly in pain or not at ease. The prefix dis means not.
Bahasa Indonesia: ketidaknyamanan
Example: He felt some discomfort in his foot after wearing new shoes.
